All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health) contains 3 panels, in order: **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** A new dashboard titled **fwgr15-n1 Bench Dashboard** was created and saved. It contains a **Stat** panel titled **fwgr15-n1 Availability**. Verified by opening the panel's editor: visualization type = "Stat", panel title = "fwgr15-n1 Availability", query data source = **TestData** (query row A shows "(TestData)", Scenario: Random Walk). The panel renders TestData output ("A-series", value 18.5).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled **fwgr15-n1 Notes** whose rendered content is exactly **"Notes for run fwgr15-n1"** — confirmed to contain the runid `fwgr15-n1`. Dashboard saved ("Dashboard saved" alert observed).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard settings show Tags = **["bench"]** (verified in the General settings page after a fresh load). The time range picker shows **"Last 6 hours"**, and the loaded URL carries `from=now-6h&to=now`. Saved with the "Update default time range" option checked.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The auto-refresh interval is **1m** — the refresh control next to the time picker displays "1m", and the loaded URL carries `refresh=1m`. Saved with the "Update default refresh value" option checked.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Dashboard URL: **http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffwrhph5lc8owc/fwgr15-n1-bench-dashboard** (full URL with state: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffwrhph5lc8owc/fwgr15-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`). Dashboard UID: **ffwrhph5lc8owc**. It lives in the "Dashboards" folder.

All six objectives succeeded; every value above was read back from the page after a fresh navigation, not assumed.
